items.stem: A designer changes the corner radius on one button and must repeat it on 20 others across the file. What should they have set up?

options.text: A single component used as instances, so one edit to the component updates every instance
options.rationale: Correct: components propagate changes to all their instances, avoiding repetitive manual edits.
Groups do not share a definition, so each must be edited individually.
Locking prevents edits but does not share a definition.
Canvas size is irrelevant to component reuse.

items.explanation: Correct: components propagate changes to all their instances, avoiding repetitive manual edits.

items.stem: Which TWO practices directly support accessible, legible UI design? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Ensuring sufficient colour contrast between text and its background
options.rationale: Correct: adequate contrast is a core accessibility requirement for readable text.

options.text: Using a consistent spacing and type scale for clear hierarchy
options.rationale: Correct: consistent spacing and type hierarchy aid readability and scanning.

options.text: Using the smallest readable font to fit more content
options.rationale: Shrinking type to cram content harms legibility and accessibility.

options.text: Removing all labels to reduce clutter
options.rationale: Removing labels hurts comprehension and accessibility.

items.explanation: Correct: adequate contrast is a core accessibility requirement for readable text.

items.stem: A component built without auto layout breaks when its label text gets longer. What is the fix?

options.text: Apply auto layout so the component resizes to fit its content with consistent padding
options.rationale: Correct: auto layout makes a component adapt to content length while keeping spacing.

options.text: Set a fixed width large enough for any text
options.rationale: A fixed width wastes space or still clips longer text.

options.text: Rasterise the component to an image
options.rationale: Flattening to an image removes editability entirely.
Removing the label defeats the component's purpose.

items.explanation: Correct: auto layout makes a component adapt to content length while keeping spacing.
